title: The Garden of the Glass Steppe Revisited
author: Ines Villalobos
blurb: Ivo Zhou, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
